visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, dressed in a stylish light blue sleeveless top with ruffled layers, sits centrally before six elementary-aged children. The kids are wearing their school uniforms, featuring green and yellow polo shirts. They are in a classroom with whiteboards decorated with educational posters and charts. Animated Peppa Pig characters float near the top of the frame. (2) The woman brings a polished silver flute to her mouth and begins playing a rhythmic melody. The students behind her immediately react by jumping slightly and thrusting their arms into the air with excitement. Animated pink exclamation marks and sparkles flicker above their heads as they smile brightly. The woman maintains a focused yet playful facial expression while playing. (3) As the woman plays a second upbeat tune, the children continue to raise their hands, competing to answer. A bright yellow Baby Shark animated graphic slides into the bottom right corner of the frame. The classroom lighting is bright and even, highlighting the detailed textures of the ruffles and the children's hair. The woman lowers the flute and smiles. (4) In the final segment, the woman performs a third song while the children cheer. Colorful animated mushrooms with playful expressions appear at the bottom. The entire group then looks towards the camera and waves their hands vigorously in a friendly farewell gesture as the video concludes, with cartoon applause graphics appearing.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-pitched, cheerful female voice greeting the audience and asking the children if they are ready for a challenge. The children respond with a loud, enthusiastic "Ready!" in Mandarin. A light electronic background music track with a moderate tempo plays continuously underneath the speech. (2) A clear, melodic flute solo cuts through the mix, playing the recognizable Peppa Pig theme. The acoustics suggest a classroom environment with slight natural room resonance. Following the melody, there is a burst of high-arousal children's cheering and laughter, punctuated by a short, percussive "correct answer" chime SFX. (3) The second flute performance features the "Baby Shark" rhythm, played with crisp articulation and breathy flute textures. The BGM synth pads swell slightly in volume during the pauses. The main female speaker uses a warm, teasing tone to select a student to answer. The children’s voices are dense and energetic. (4) A third flute melody is heard, followed by more cheering and a celebratory bell sound effect. The audio track concludes with the group waving and shouting goodbye in high spirits. A synthesized crowd applause track is layered over the ending, alongside a soft fading electronic chime.
